title: The Woodman and the Trees
summary: The trees gave an ash branch to the woodman for an axe handle. Fitted with the wood, the axe felled the entire forest, teaching that sacrificing the humble destroys the mighty....
full_text: The trees gave an ash branch to the woodman for an axe handle. Fitted with the wood, the axe felled the entire forest, teaching that sacrificing the humble destroys the mighty.
moral: Surrendering a small brother to the enemy ensures your own destruction.
